limitations: No licensed multi-platform reputation feed is contracted for Hotel Explorer.
Google Reviews / Places review storage is not authorized (Places ToS / storage policy).
Tripadvisor / Booking.com / Expedia consumer scrapes are blocked; Rapid/Demand APIs are stubs pending credentials + ToS review.
This packet stores public listing aggregates and category scores only — no full review bodies.
Category scores are platform-published aggregates, not operational KPIs or CapEx proof.
No historical observation series — trend windows are unavailable.
Expedia category breakdown was not captured in the rights-gated research pass.
Tripadvisor Location / Rooms / Value / Service bubble scores were incomplete in SERP extraction; only clearly attributed category scores are retained.

insights.executiveSummary: Bethesda Marriott shows mid-to-upper public listing scores across Tripadvisor (4.1/5), Booking.com (8.0/10), and Expedia (8.6/10). Booking category scores highlight cleanliness and comfort as relative strengths and value for money as the softer category. Tripadvisor sleep-quality and cleanliness bubbles are relatively firm where captured. Location / shuttle / aging-product themes appear in public commentary summaries but are not treated as measured causes here. No time-series is available — do not infer renovation or service-recovery trends from this snapshot.
followUps: Ask the GM whether Metro/shuttle and parking guest guidance matches what listings imply for arrival experience.
Compare Value for Money perception against corridor Upper Upscale peers before any rate or package changes.
If CapEx or room-refresh narrative is material, request ops evidence (work orders, guest-recovery logs) — do not treat category scores as proof.
